name: Strict Cinematic UI Guardrails - REVIA V2
description: Overrides generic AI slop. Forces a dark, premium, Apple TV+ / Linear.app aesthetic.

banned_elements: NO flat white or gray backgrounds. Base MUST be OLED Black (#050505).
NO massive border radii. Use sharp or very slightly rounded edges.
NO floating soft drop-shadows on cards. Use 1px subtle borders with backdrop-blur.
typography_and_layout: RTL Layout must be strictly preserved for Arabic (Cairo Font).

default_component_styling.cards: Use the .glass-panel and .card-hover classes defined in globals.css.
default_component_styling.modals_and_nav: Use .sheet-glass and .dock-glass for bottom nav and sheets.
